package.name: super_odometry_vio
package.description: Visual odometry module for the SuperOdom 2021-parity effort. Contains the VINS-Mono algorithm core (camera models, feature tracking, sliding-window estimator) as a ROS-independent library plus a thin ROS2 adapter, so VIO constraints can feed the central IMU odometry. Core sources originate from VINS-Mono (GPL-3.0), see docs/THIRD_PARTY.md.
